description: This header file defines functions and constants for handling hexadecimal representations of object IDs and hashes in a Git-like system. It includes functions for converting between binary and hexadecimal formats, parsing hexadecimal object IDs, and handling algorithm-specific hashes.

methods.name: get_oid_hex_algop
methods.description: Reads a hash in hexadecimal format and outputs its binary form, supporting different hash algorithms.

methods.name: hash_to_hex_algop_r
methods.description: Converts binary hash to hexadecimal string using a specific algorithm, reentrant version with user-provided buffer.

methods.name: oid_to_hex_r
methods.description: Converts object ID to hexadecimal string in a reentrant manner.

methods.name: hash_to_hex_algop
methods.description: Converts binary hash to hexadecimal string for a specific algorithm, static buffer result.

methods.name: oid_to_hex
methods.description: Converts object ID to hexadecimal string, static buffer.

methods.name: parse_oid_hex_algop
methods.description: Parses a hexadecimal object ID string into binary form, supporting different hash algorithms.

methods.name: get_oid_hex_any
methods.description: Detects hash algorithm based on hex length and parses accordingly.

methods.name: parse_oid_hex_any
methods.description: Parses a hexadecimal object ID of any supported algorithm.

methods.name: get_hash_hex
methods.description: Parses a hexadecimal hash string into binary form for the repository's algorithm.

methods.name: parse_oid_hex
methods.description: Parses a hexadecimal object ID into binary form, based on the specific algorithm.

methods.name: hash_to_hex
methods.description: Converts a hash to its hexadecimal representation, using the repository's algorithm.
